records.name: Assisted pull-up
setupNotes: Bar + band
Clear space, secure equipment and a controlled exit are required where relevant.
prerequisiteNotes: Demonstrate comfortable entry, controlled movement and a safe exit before adding difficulty. Completion does not certify skill.
technique: Check a secure bar and an undamaged band
Use assistance to pull chest toward the bar
Lower under control; enter and exit the band carefully
records.easier: Controlled supported practice with a qualified instructor
records.harder: Use less assistance before unassisted pull-ups
caveats: Stop for sharp or worsening pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness; seek appropriate help if symptoms persist.
Use a comfortable range and normal breathing. Existing restrictions or recent surgery need individualized professional guidance; this record cannot clear participation.
Check the bar and band attachment; use a stable step for entry and exit. Do not drop when grip fades.
